title: Reports
description: Reservations, confirmations, revenue, collections, expenses, staff share, business share, operating result and stock; per day, per branch and for the period.

head_office_hint: Records of accounts without a branch
filters.title: Filters
scope.title: What this report covers
scope.period: {{from}} – {{to}} ({{timezone}}). Appointments count on their start day in the branch time zone, sales and money movements on the day they were recorded.
scope.head_office_included: Transfers, income, expenses and staff payouts of accounts without a branch (head office) are included.
scope.head_office_excluded: Records of accounts without a branch (head office) are not included.
scope.formula: Operating result = revenue − product cost − staff share − expenses. Other income, collections, transfers and staff payouts are outside it.
scope.separate: Revenue, collections, account transfers and staff payouts come from separate records; none is added to another.
scope.staff_omitted: Not shown with a staff filter: {{fields}}. These amounts are not tied to a staff member.
scope.stock: The stock rows show the movements of the period and the stock now; the staff filter does not apply to stock.
scope.packages: Package sales will be added as a separate line once the package module is on.
